name: iterable-operations-with-var-mutability-tests-161bbbc0e0/basic-iterable-with-variable-mutability-e.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions / Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.map lists only length, keys, hasKey, get, remove; ballerina/lang.array lists map but not filter.

Subset restrictions / Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" lists map:length, map:keys, map:hasKey, map:get, map:remove and array:map, but omits map:entries, map:map, map:filter, map:forEach and array:filter.
Expressions: "Anonymous function expression"; Statements: "Local variable declarations" and "Compound Assignment".
reason: The case depends on unsupported map entries/map/filter/forEach operations and array filter operations, including their callbacks mutating captured variables. These essential operations fall outside the explicit langlib and method-call positive lists, so the whole case is a feature gap even though anonymous functions and assignments are supported.
test_design_notes: The supplied source marks unused-variable diagnostics for t, count, filteredArr and y; negative diagnostics do not remove its dependence on unsupported iterable operations.
No external runtime assertions were supplied; the functions expose captured-variable mutations through returned counts, strings and collections.
